tasks.title: Build a Responsive Landing Page
tasks.shortDescription: Create a mobile-first landing page for a short film platform.
tasks.fullDescription: Build a responsive landing page using HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript. It should have a hero section, a featured films grid and a newsletter form.
requirements: Hero section with call to action
Featured films grid with at least 6 cards
acceptanceCriteria: Page is usable on a 360px wide screen
Email field shows an error for invalid input
Lighthouse accessibility score of 90 or more

tasks.title: REST API for Film Submissions
tasks.shortDescription: Create a small REST API to accept and list film submissions.
tasks.fullDescription: Build a Node.js and Express API with MongoDB. Support creating a submission, listing submissions with pagination and fetching one submission by id.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid input returns a 400 with a clear message
